Projects

Engineering Work

Research and coursework projects spanning computational simulation, structural analysis, thermodynamics, and embedded systems.

★ Flagship Research

Computational FSI Simulation of Bat Flight

Fluid-structure interaction modeling of bat flight with membrane perforations. Extended and validated an FSI codebase at UTSI.

FiredrakePETScFSIHPCPython

Wooden I-Beam Optimization

Derived stress and failure-load equations for an asymmetric pine I-beam, then built a Python optimizer to balance three failure modes within 20% of each other.

PythonMechanics of MaterialsTeam of 6

Geothermal Heat Pump Design

Selected R-32 from five candidate refrigerants and modeled a year-round geothermal cycle in EES for a 12.3 kW load — COP 4.30 heating, 1.83 cooling.

EESThermodynamicsIndividual

Over-Terrain Vehicle

Designed the magnetic-puck detection subsystem using a Faraday induction coil, then pivoted to a Hall-effect sensor. Co-wired the Arduino electronics.
